patch_description: The second program achieved the best score (0.72) with only 14 parameters using a unified shared RZ layer and RY rotations with CZ entanglement. The current program regressed to 0.66 despite more parameters by replacing CZ with CRZ. This change reverts to the winning structure but substitutes RX for RY on all qubits, following the recommendation to "isolate the impact of rotation axis choice on expressivity." RX may better couple with the fixed input encoding than RY, potentially improving the parameter efficiency score further while maintaining convergence speed. This keeps n_params at 2 (rx_shared and rz_shared).
